right people! im a judge! I got a pm from sweep and i accepted it. I'll play the maps now then I'll edit this post to type what I think of each map.

=====================================
Maximo - Speed Park

Appearance
It looks nice. But the bounce block looks a little out of place since its a mostly tile map. I like the design of the top left bit (the kind of loop thingy) - 3.5 points

Loading time/lag
No lag and quick loading time. - 5 points

Ease of use
Nice flow but there was a jump or two that i had trouble doing, I would have prefered to be able to do all the jumps pretty easily but it was still good. As I mentioned earlier i liked that bit at the top left. - 7.5 points

Fun factor
You feel really good when you do all the jumps correctly and nothing goes wrong. I dont really know what else to say but it was alot of fun.
- 14 points

Quality & Quantity of cool stuff N can do on the map
Theres a nice variety of jumps to do and most of them are pretty good and fun. Again I have to say again that I loved that top left jump. I didnt understand that bounce block though. But there was some nice things to do in it. - 23 points

Ninja rating
If it was on numa I would probably rate it a 3. - 3 points

Originality
I dont really know what to say about its originality.... - 7 points

Overall thoughts on map
It felt to me that the bottom part of the map felt a little cramped. Its a good map though and its what I expected. - 8 points

TOTAL- (wait let me add it up!) 71 I think....

====================================
Red_Reamer - AirborNe

Appearance
Simple and I liked the bottom tiles. I didnt like the one way positioning. It worked well but it didnt look good. - 3.5 points

Loading time/lag
The one ways and bounce blocks made it take a bit longer than maximos so you get a 4. - 4 points

Ease of use
The bounceblocks are tricky and Its hard if you cant use the bounceblocks well. But it was cool when you get it right.- 7 points

Fun factor
Its ok....the flow wasnt that good though and once i had gotten the gold I didnt really wanna play it again.... - 7 points

Quality & Quantity of cool stuff N can do on the map
Theres hardly anything to do but the quality of it was nice. - 12 points

Ninja rating
If it was on numa i'd give it a 2 - 2 points

Originality
Not much original except the wall of bounce blocks... - 6 points

Overall thoughts on map
Its a decent map but hardly any replay value. I didnt feel like playing it again once I had got the gold. If there was a few more tricks to do in it, it could really boost its points. - 5.5 points

TOTAL - 46.5 points i think....

Well I have thought of an idea for a contest!

The idea is to make a map with only one line of data thingy....if you dont know what im talking about then look at this screenshot.



See the circled line of dots? You need to make a map with a maximum of one of these lines.

Three entries per person! If you wish to submit another map and you already have three then you must take one of your maps out of the contest!

This means the amount of objects must be keep to a minimum.

The way of scoring.....

[Amount of data]: Amount of dots....the less the better I suppose.....rated out of 5.

[Originality]: How original the map is....try and make your map unique! Rated out of 10

[Appearance] Does it look good? Rated out of 5

[Flow] Does it have a good flow? Rated out of 5

[Fun-ness/fun factor/whatever] Is it fun to play? This is important. Rated out of 20

#4893 1 2005-10-26T16:44:07Z glenno14
I downloaded it a few days ago and its great. Its a MMOFPS (Massively Multiplayer Online First Person Shooter or something like that) so you get to play online with real people. Theres a campaign mode where you play with other people online to complete the objectives for your team (the teams are Axis and Allies by the way. The main objectives are usually to retrieve something or defend something but theres sub-objectives that you can do, such as blowing up something with dynamite. Heres an example of one of the Campaign levels.

Axis Objectives
Main objective- Prevent the Allies from stealing the gold from the bank.
Important-ish objectives- Prevent Allies from stealing the tank (If they DO get the tank you can shoot the driver to stop it and if your an engineer you can build barriers to block the tank) and stop them from blowing the bank door up.
Other objectives- I cant exactly think of them right now....I only played this level twice.

Allies objectives
Basically the opposite of the Axis objectives. (Steal gold from the bank and get the tank)

The levels are quite big and its lots of fun working together to complete the objectives.

Now for another important feature. What type of soldier will you be? Theres 5 different jobs you can choose from.

Soldier- All rounder I guess. No special abilities. (I think)

Medic- Every team needs one of these. They carry health and ammo around with them and they can revive you if you die.

Engineer- This is what I am. Engineers carry tools around to repair broken turrets or set them up or if you need a bridge built to get to the enemies base then you need an engineer (In a snow level theres a part where you need to do this) And they have dynamite. You need dynamite to complete some objectives and to blow up tank barriers and stuff. Oh and engineers have landmines. They're great.

Covert Ops and field ops- I havent been covert or field ops before. All I know is that the covert ops have backpacks that they can blow up when they press a button.

Theres an experience points system too. If you play well you get upgraded a rank. This only lasts until the end of the campaign (the campaign is usually about 3 missions) Also theres little abilities kind of thing. Theres 3 bar type things (battle sense, light weapon ability and the other depends on your job) and if you do well in that certain catogory you get 1 square up on the bar (theres 4 squares) and you get rewarded. For example when you level up for the first time in light weapons, you get a bigger ammunition capacity. Do well in battle sense and you get yourself a pair of binoculars. And the other catogory depends on your job. In engineering the bar goes up if you repair things and set up lots of stuff. For the first square in engineering you get rewarded with better skill with explosives. You get the idea. The abilities also disappear at the end of the campaign. You can also earn medals by being skilled in a certain thing such as being skilled with heavy weaponry (turrets and stuff).

Oh and after each round theres little awards such as "highest accuracy" and "No friends award" These dont really do anything but they're a nice little addition.

Great game.

Oh I almost forgot to post a link....

Download page

Oh and it's for Mac too!

EDIT: Thats gotta be my longest post without me using "..." instead of fullstops and commas.

I have seen this game on lots of forums but I didn't find it when I searched here. Basically there will be a list of N enemies and items and you choose which ones to hurt and which ones to heal. Each enemy and item will have 20 points to start off with. I am not putting N in because he will most likely get healed by everyone and then the game would be unfair on everyone else.

Zap Drone- 20
Seeker Drone- 20
Laser Drone- 20
Chain Gun Drone- 20
Thwump- 20
Mine- 20
Gauss Turret- 20
Floor Guard- 20
Rockets- 20
Gold- 20
Bounce Block- 20
Trap Door- 20
Locked Door- 20
Exit Door- 20
One Way Platform- 20
Launch Pad- 20

When you post you can either take away 2 points from one item or enemy (This is called hurting) You can add 2 points to one item or enemy (This is called healing) Or you can heal one thing and hurt another! I made it sound a little confusing but its very simple.


READ THIS!
You can only post to hurt or heal once an hour!
Copy and paste the list everytime you post!
